title: The initial Islet-1 blueprint
summary: The first public version of the blueprint: {{studies}} studies and {{findings}} findings, the Idea Graveyard, {{designs}} designs scored on five tests, and the five layers of checks.

title: Test delayed and reduced vascular oxygen support together
summary: Asks what happens to the graft's oxygen supply when new blood vessels connect late and carry less oxygen than hoped, both at once.

outcome.note: The blueprint now tests late-forming blood vessels and weaker oxygen delivery together, under both ways the cells release oxygen, and publishes the whole grid, so it shows where the oxygen margin runs out.

title: The published chance-of-working estimate does not compute the quantity it states, and omits failure modes the blueprint already documents
summary: Asks that the odds on the Blueprint page say exactly what they measure, how the three-design figure is worked out, and which checks they leave out.

outcome.note: The odds now define each step as a design still in the running clearing the next hurdle, give the reason for each hurdle's three-design figure, and name the lab checks that sit outside the four hurdles, so they cannot be read as the chance of a cure.

title: Measure endocrine function after the modelled oxygen bridge and during recovery
summary: Asks whether the cells that survive the 14-day low-oxygen window still release insulin and glucagon normally afterwards, and adds a side-by-side lab test during and after recovery.

outcome.note: The blueprint now tests whether the cells that survive the 14-day low-oxygen window after transplant still release insulin and glucagon normally during and after recovery, separating lost cells from weakened ones before counting the working dose.

title: Test whether cell-free product effluent has PD-L1-dependent functional activity
summary: Asks whether cell-free liquid conditioned by the engineered islet cells can suppress a separately stimulated immune response through the PD-L1 brake, and adds a controlled lab screen to test it.

outcome.note: The blueprint now adds a controlled lab check of whether liquid collected from around the engineered islet cells can calm a separate immune response on its own, alongside the existing tests of how much protective protein stays on the cells and how much is shed into the liquid.

title: Compare intermediate endocrine mixtures at measured functional output and graft burden
summary: Asks whether islet-cell mixes between the current 60:30:10 recipe and insulin-cells-only controls can cut tissue volume or oxygen need while keeping hormone regulation intact, and adds a staged lab comparison.

outcome.note: The blueprint now adds a staged lab comparison of a few in-between cell mixes against the current 60:30:10 recipe, to see whether a slightly bigger share of insulin-making cells could mean fewer cells are needed, without weakening the other islet cells' protection against low blood sugar. The 60:30:10 recipe stays unless new measurements justify a change.

title: A human immune model in each well to evaluate islet graft responses
summary: Asks whether a combined human immune and islet co-culture at Stage 1 could catch failure modes between immune cell types that split Stage-0 tests miss.

outcome.note: Adds open question OQ-017 and a Stage-1 note beside Readout 3 asking whether a combined human immune and islet co-culture can catch cross-talk between immune cell types that split Stage-0 tests miss, once donor-mismatch background and cluster recovery from the gel are qualified.

title: Two factual errors in the evidence records behind OQ-008 and GY-009
summary: Points out that Xu 2024 tested surface-anchored CD47 in non-islet models rather than stem-cell islets, and separates Hu 2023's primary human islet CD47 threshold from its stem-cell islet counts.

outcome.note: Reclassifies Xu 2024 from stem-cell islets to its actual non-islet immune, blood-stem-cell and endothelial models (nudging Design A's overall score from 0.1085 to 0.1084), removes Xu 2024 from Idea Graveyard rule GY-009, and separates Hu 2023's primary human islet CD47 threshold arm from its engineered stem-cell islet counts.

title: Design X is scored under one name but specified as two products
summary: Asks that every mention of Design X across the blueprint, tissue simulations and open questions state whether it refers to the scored insulin-gene edit or the unscored Stage-0 upgrade bundle.

outcome.note: Maps each blueprint table, tissue simulation and open question explicitly to either the scored Design X grid comparison (Design A plus one insulin-gene base edit on the 119 µm oxygen layer) or the unscored Stage-0 Design X upgrade bundle (100 µm oxygen layer and outer-ring Fas-ligand gel), and widens OQ-015 across Designs A, B and X.

title: Carrying the 68-hour oxygen-release half-life across a reformulated source lamina
summary: Points out that the 68-hour oxygen-release half-life comes from a 25 wt% silicone disk and may shift in denser 31.25 wt% and 46.39 wt% microbeads, requiring per-recipe testing and sensitivity bounds.

outcome.note: Reclassifies the 68-hour oxygen-release half-life as an unvalidated per-recipe target rather than a fixed material constant, publishes an 84-run sensitivity sweep showing the safe half-life window for both the 31.25 wt% and 46.39 wt% peroxide recipes, and requires Stage-0 particle-size and release-rate measurements for each recipe.

title: Qualify core knock-in cis/splicing boundaries, SLC30A8 hold, iCasp9 3D references and seed-line TYK2 sensitivity
summary: Adds early lab checks for nearby inflammatory genes, host-gene splicing and promoter silencing around the core DNA edits, keeps ZnT8 intact until proved safe for islet yield, and adds 3D safety-switch and 10,000-patient donor-line audits.

outcome.note: The blueprint now checks nearby genes, host-gene splicing and anti-silencing switches around its core DNA edits, holds off deleting the zinc transporter ZnT8 until stem-cell yield and insulin output are proved, audits three crystal structures of the safety switch, and tests how a naturally protective TYK2 donor cell line affects the 10,000-patient simulation.

title: Add post-adjunct depletion assays, ectopic CD55 complement gates and held Stage-0 challenger falsifiers
summary: Adds lab tests to check whether islet grafts stay protected after their temporary immune-calming gel proteins wear off, isolates any benefit of added CD55 without harming insulin release, and holds four candidate gene edits behind strict proof gates.

outcome.note: The Stage-0 lab contract now tests never-treated, gel-depleted and active grafts side by side once immune-calming gel proteins wear off, checks added CD55 on the exact same edited graft without disturbing endogenous CD59 insulin release, and holds four candidate edits (TYMS, NLRC5, endogenous CD274 and TXNIP) outside core designs behind strict pass rules.

title: Add a thrombomodulin module to counter IBMIR, which CD47 and HLA-E do not cover
summary: Asks to add a thrombomodulin gene-edit module to protect transplanted islet cells from early blood clotting and complement attack, and to split Test 3 into separate scores for immune cells and clotting.

outcome.note: The plan already includes local thrombomodulin and whole-blood clotting and complement checks; the cited studies do not establish added benefit from a permanent THBD gene edit or justify changing Test 3 scoring, and the planned graft still needs lab validation.

title: Empirical qualification of implanted-form CaO2 microbead oxygen kinetics for the Islet-1 slab geometry
summary: Asks to measure oxygen release, hydrogen peroxide levels, cell survival and insulin release for the oxygen-producing microbeads in the actual 350 µm implant slab before relying on the 68-hour model target.

outcome.note: IIP-0010 already requires testing each oxygen-bead recipe in its implanted form for particle size and oxygen release, alongside peroxide checks and IIP-0004 hormone-function tests; these lab measurements remain to be run.

title: Add two-strand knock-in splice-grammar census, Mode-B challenger comparators and UMI/RT-PCR isoform gates
summary: Maps unintended two-way RNA splicing and repeated DNA across the inserted protective genes, sets up one-change-at-a-time test sequences alongside the untouched reference designs, and adds calibrated RNA and safety-switch lab checks.

outcome.note: The blueprint now scans inserted DNA in both directions for unintended RNA splicing and repeated sequences, registers synthesis-ready one-change-at-a-time Stage-0 challenger sequences alongside the untouched reference donors across Loci 1, 3 and 4, and requires calibrated RNA recovery, host-gene 3′-end and orientation controls before any sequence change advances.

title: Reconcile HLA-E*01:03 NKG2A/NKG2C selectivity audit and register 20-construct Mode-B S10 comparator panel
summary: Reconciles the six human leader-peptide affinities on HLA-E*01:03, registers 20 two-strand splice-hardened Stage-0 HLA-E comparator sequences alongside the untouched reference DNA, and tightens the adaptive natural-killer and T-cell lab gates.

outcome.note: The blueprint now reconciles all six human leader peptides in Lin 2023 on HLA-E*01:03 (0/6 reaching the static 4.0× NKG2C/NKG2A ratio, kept separate from HLA-E*01:01 monomer datasets), ships a 20-construct two-strand splice-hardened Stage-0 HLA-E comparator FASTA alongside the untouched reference designs, and binds Stage-0 Switch S10 to paired NK subset, UL40 T-cell and Treg lab gates.

title: Add human-proteome peptide census, Design B2 TYK2 P1104A HLA-C gate and AlphaMissense provenance
summary: Adds a species-separated human-proteome-subtracted synthetic-peptide census across Design A and Design B constructs, enforces a recipient-genotype-stratified Stage-0 HLA-C neoantigen hold gate for Design B2 (TYK2 P1104A), and records open-license AlphaMissense v3 variant provenance.

outcome.note: The blueprint now runs a species-separated human-Swiss-Prot peptide census across 22 molecular species (comparing canonical P2A against existing 2A-free Locus-3 donors), enforces a fail-closed Stage-0 OR-hold gate on Design B2's TYK2 P1104A SAPTKFLEL peptide across genotyped G/G, G/C and C/C recipients and HLA-C alleles, and records non-gating CC-BY-4.0 AlphaMissense v3 provenance.

title: Add Locus-3 Multi-miR(IL1R1+FAS) 6-arm challenger suite and GRCh38 zero-bystander CBE stop needles
summary: Pre-registers a 6-arm two-strand splice- and seed-hardened Locus-3 intronic Multi-miR(IL1R1 + FAS) Stage-0 challenger suite inside the single-AAV6 cap alongside seven standalone zero-bystander FAS and IL1R1 base-editor stop comparators, and retires soluble endothelial decoy-receptor alternatives.

outcome.note: Screening 112 T1D genetic regions ruled out 16 misleading gene targets (including CLEC16A vs DEXI) and converged on IL1R1 and FAS. The blueprint now ships a held 6-arm Locus-3 Multi-miR(IL1R1+FAS) synthetic-intron FASTA (inside one AAV6 cap) plus seven standalone FAS/IL1R1 base-editor stop comparators, retiring soluble endothelial IL1R2 decoys.

title: Add Layer-4 explicit-3D clumping, microbead-H2O2 barrier and Design-Z micro-optode gates
summary: Adds a Gate-3D-V-verified explicit-3D tissue-transport audit quantifying lateral SC-islet clumping, discrete edge-bead peroxide plumes and 140 µm bead-free boundary thresholds in Layer 4, and enforces fail-closed Stage-0 physical qualification gates for Rule S6 spacing, Gate P05 catalase barrier films and two-stage Design Z oxygen checks.

outcome.note: The blueprint now runs an explicit-3D Layer-4 transport audit (40–60% unpatterned 100 µm cluster hypoxia at 1,500 IEQ/cm², 6.9–19.5 µM uncoated edge-bead peroxide plumes, and dose-matched 80 µm spacing) and enforces fail-closed Stage-0 gates for microwell spacing, wet-sieved beads + >= 20 µm catalase barrier films (73,800 IU retained) and two-stage Design Z oxygen checks.

title: Add extracellular biomaterial foreign-antigen census, human catalase lock, humoral cuff gates and odds reassessment
summary: Extends the 20,429-protein human-Swiss-Prot foreign-peptide census to extracellular biomaterial and cuff proteins, locks Gate P05 to recombinant human catalase (P04040), enforces fail-closed anti-PEG, Day-28 anti-streptavidin, DPR-maleimide ring-hydrolysis and 72-h hepatocyte gates alongside held human CFH + THBD + ADIPOQ-Hexa-FasL comparators, and reassesses the four-hurdle computational odds to 27%, 31%, 36% and 53% across all three blueprints.

outcome.note: The blueprint now audits extracellular pouch/cuff proteins against 20,429 human Swiss-Prot entries, locks Gate P05 catalase to recombinant human P04040, enforces anti-PEG, Day-28 anti-SA, DPR-maleimide and 72-h hepatocyte gates alongside held human CFH+THBD+Hexa-FasL cuff comparators, and reassesses four-hurdle computational odds to 27% / 31% / 36% (53% across all three).

title: Add Layer-4 lineage-partitioned OCR helper, M101 reservoir bound and Stage-0 redox/rest conditioning gates
summary: Adds a backward-compatible two-scale lineage-partitioned intrinsic-OCR helper to Layer 4, records parameterized Design Z post-washout/PFC bounds, staged (v = 0.18, 0.36, 0.60) exercise insulin-lag limits and the closed-slab M101 reservoir bound (< 9 s above 15 mmHg), and pre-registers fail-closed Stage-0 120-h OCR plus 4-arm Nec-1s × Ferrostatin-1 pellet-washout and NQO1 gates while keeping 791.5 mg CaO2 and 88% Hurdle-1 unchanged.

outcome.note: The blueprint now partitions whole-slab and single-cluster oxygen demand in Layer 4, logs parameterized Design Z post-washout/PFC bounds, staged exercise lag limits and the closed-slab M101 reservoir bound (< 9 s above 15 mmHg), and adds Stage-0 120-h OCR plus 4-arm Nec-1s × Ferrostatin-1 pellet-washout and NQO1 gates while keeping 791.5 mg CaO2 and 88% Hurdle-1.

title: Split Track-2 NK rescue contract, add PVR/necroptosis guardrails and 2^12 portfolio generator
summary: Splits Track-2 B'-SCT (KIR) and held HLA-G1 (LILRB1) natural-killer rescue routes fail-closed with upper95 subset routing, adds CC0 RCSB PDB PVR and HLA-G1 structural provenance plus off-grid Idea Graveyard guardrails for B2M-null CD155/CD226 sign-inversion testing and lineage-separated necroptosis, and computes the 4,096-state common-shock portfolio tree programmatically with zero change to headline odds.

outcome.note: The blueprint now splits Track-2 B'-SCT (KIR) and held HLA-G1 (LILRB1) NK rescue routes fail-closed with upper95 subset routing, logs CC0 RCSB PDB PVR and HLA-G1 coordinate provenance plus off-grid Idea Graveyard guardrails for B2M-null CD155/CD226 testing and lineage-separated necroptosis, and computes the 4,096-state common-shock portfolio tree programmatically with zero odds change.

title: Upgrade Design Y wildcard with eePASSIGE polarity, TadCBEd, ADORA1 physics and Y-01..Y-04 gates
summary: Upgrades the unscored Stage-0 Design Y landing-pad wildcard strictly inside the <= 20% Y/Z firewall (zero change to Blueprints A, B, or X or headline odds), materializing the 3-comparator FASTA, inverting Bxb1 polarity to eePASSIGE attP-in-genome, comparing TadCBEd vs CRISPRoff, modeling human ADORA1/ADORA2A diffusion, and adding a fail-closed 23-endpoint Y-01..Y-04 contract.

outcome.note: The blueprint now specifies Stage-0 wildcard Design Y strictly inside the <= 20% Y/Z cap (zero change to A, B, X or headline odds), adding the 3-comparator FASTA, eePASSIGE B2M attP-in-genome polarity, TadCBEd vs CRISPRoff haplotype/CGI checks, human ADORA1/ADORA2A reaction-diffusion, and a fail-closed 23-endpoint Y-01..Y-04 contract.

title: Harden Stage-0 batch provenance, donor-blocked 6 + 6 bank equivalence and imprinting/XCI/MDM4/mtDNA guardrails
summary: Enforces immutable 4/5/7-key bank, lot and device provenance scopes (blocking cross-lot evidence carryover, stale SE pairing, fractional cell denominators and unlatched safety stops), registers non-executable wildcard entry ISLET1_Z_X_MOL_140UM_ZERO_CAO2, replaces normal cut-offs with exact Student-t and 6 + 6 two-seedline Welch 90% TOST equivalence, adds IC1/IC2/IG-DMR, 46,XX XCI, 1q32.1 MDM4 and 1,000x mtDNA gates (GY-018, GY-019), and hardens Layers 1, 3, 4 and 5 with zero score or odds change.

outcome.note: The blueprint now isolates bank-, batch- and device-level Stage-0 evidence under immutable 4/5/7-key scopes with integer rare-event bounds and latched safety stops (GY-018), registers non-executable ISLET1_Z_X_MOL_140UM_ZERO_CAO2, enforces Donor-1 paired blocking plus 6+6 two-seedline Welch TOST and IC1/IC2/IG-DMR, 46,XX XCI, MDM4 and mtDNA checks (GY-019), and hardens Layers 1, 3, 4 and 5.

title: Enforce Layer-4 unrounded worst-face oxygen gates, two-timepoint human P04040 catalase envelope hold and B1–B3 route challengers
summary: Replaces spatial-average and display-rounded 3D oxygen checks with unrounded multi-mesh dual-band worst-face gates (catching 12.64–13.05 mmHg edge dips on 100 µm clusters and 14.29 mmHg on 30 mmHg Design Z), binds Gate P05 strictly to every CaO2 assembly across both Day-7 (>= 70%) and Day-14 (>= 73,800 IU) human P04040 retention with z = 70.0 µm peroxide (<= 2.5 µM) and unrounded endotoxin limits (<= 0.50 EU), separates Day-30/90 retrieval from dual-assay zero-event shedding, pre-registers zero-primate Contrasts B1–B3, and adds GY-020 with zero score or odds change.

outcome.note: The blueprint now gates 3D pouches on unrounded multi-mesh worst-face oxygen (>= 15.0 mmHg surface and >= 5.0 mmHg core, updating PMID 21788581 to PMID 21788575), product-binds Day-7/Day-14 human P04040 catalase, z = 70 µm peroxide and unrounded endotoxin caps to every CaO2 assembly (GY-020), separates Day-30/90 retrieval from zero-event shedding, and registers Contrasts B1–B3.

title: Harden gnomAD v4.1 and 17-record HLA-C provenance, stage 2A-free Design B comparator FASTA under 4-state lifecycle and retire INS 3′-UTR knock-ins
summary: Replaces fixed dbSnp155 screening frequencies with a 69-key VCF-normalized gnomAD v4.1 join (49/69 AN > 0 either modality; WGS 26 PASS / 1 AS_VQSR / 42 unresolved on unrounded ratios), scopes 11 HLA-A and 6 HLA-B Exon 2–3 < 0.05 WT-CFD guides across 17 HLA-C records with matched HLA-E-only DT9 controls, stages the 6-construct 2A-free Design B comparator FASTA (c1 + c5 bound at State 3, execution_supported = false), holds PE4max and 63k/90k-GE Design Y ddPCR specs, and retires INS 3′-UTR EIF4G2 knock-ins (OQ-011) into GY-022 alongside GY-021 with zero score or odds change.

outcome.note: The blueprint now joins 69 target variants to gnomAD v4.1 on unrounded ratios, scopes HLA-A/B guides across 17 HLA-C records with matched HLA-E-only DT9 controls and per-locus BAF checks (GY-021), stages the 6-construct 2A-free Design B FASTA on State-3 hold (execution_supported = false), holds PE4max and 63k/90k-GE Design Y ddPCR, and retires INS 3′-UTR knock-ins (OQ-011, GY-022).

title: Add post-depletion Design A vs B ADCC routing, measured-potency low-OCR mixture, and orthogonal IAPP gates
summary: Enforces registry-bound arm-separated Gate 0d checks without cross-arm batch borrowing, caps both intact-serum lysis and IgG-attributable CD16+ ADCC increment at U95_t <= 5.0%, pre-registers a paired Design A vs ISLET1_B2_5LOCUS_BASE responder study (n = 24–29 exact McNemar + 2×2 phi_AB tables), scales 70:20:10 loading by measured per-beta output and glucagon retention, adds 72-h/Day-28/Day-84 dual-modality IAPP checks alongside viable beta mass (GY-023), and archives NM_021999.5 ITM2B at 0% active weight.

outcome.note: The blueprint now enforces segregated Arm 1/2/3 Gate 0d checks and paired intact-plus-increment CD16+ ADCC limits (<= 5.0%), pre-registers a paired Design A vs B2 donor study (n = 24–29 + 2×2 phi_AB tables), scales 70:20:10 loading by measured output and glucagon retention, adds 72-h/Day-28/Day-84 IAPP gates (GY-023), and holds NM_021999.5 ITM2B at 0%.
